message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is the precise UI/UX analysis of the property registration form, broken down by section.

### **Header Section**
*   **Title:** "Edit Property - UPN: 865-0775-0553/865-0775-0553-1"
*   **Action:** Close (X) icon on the right.

---

### **Section 1: Location**
*Icon: Location Pin*

| Field Label | Input Type | Layout Width | Placeholder / Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Street Name** | Text Input | ~40% (Wide) | Value: *Powder St* |
| **House No.** | Text Input | ~30% (Medium) | Value: *26* |
| **Street Code** | Text Input | ~30% (Medium) | Empty |
| **GhanaPost GPS** | Text Input | 50% (Half Column) | Placeholder: *XX-XXX-XXXX* |
| **Locality Code** | Text Input | 50% (Half Column) | Empty |

---

### **Section 2: Owner Information**
*Icon: User Profile*

| Field Label | Input Type | Layout Width | Placeholder / Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Owner Name \*** | Text Input | 100% (Full Width) | Value: *Anna Kodojogah* |
| **Owner Address** | Text Input | 50% (Half Column) | Empty |
| **Owner GhanaPost GPS** | Text Input | 50% (Half Column) | Value: *VP-0029-9748* |
| **Phone \*** | Text Input | ~33% (Third) | Value: *0544370388* |
| **Email** | Text Input | ~33% (Third) | Empty |
| **TIN** | Text Input | ~33% (Third) | Empty |
| **National ID** | Text Input | 50% (Half Column) | Empty |
| **Ownership Type** | Dropdown (Select) | 50% (Half Column) | Default: *Select type* |

---

### **Section 3: Property Information**
*Icon: Building*

| Field Label | Input Type | Layout Width | Placeholder / Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Property Use Type \*** | Dropdown (Select) | ~45% (Wide) | Value: *20121 : Residential : 3rd Class Residential : 420* |
| **Value (GHS)** | Text Input | ~27.5% (Medium) | Empty |
| **Rooms** | Number/Text Input | ~27.5% (Medium) | Value: *3* |

---

### **UI/UX Design Notes for Recreation:**
*   **Layout System:** The form uses a flexible grid system.
    *   Row 1 & 2 in Location use a roughly 40/30/30 split and 50/50 split respectively.
    *   The "Phone/Email/TIN" row in Owner Information uses an equal three-column layout.
    *   Most other rows are standard 50/50 splits.
*   **Styling:**
    *   **Headers:** Light gray background (`#f5f5f5` approx), bold text with a left-aligned icon inside a subtle rounded container.
    *   **Inputs:** White background, light gray border, rounded corners (approx `4px` radius).
    *   **Typography:** Labels are small, dark gray, and positioned directly above inputs. Required fields are marked with a red asterisk (*).
    *   **Spacing:** Consistent vertical rhythm between rows (approx `16px` gap).
